sources.title: GitHub - bigcode-project/starcoder2: Home of StarCoder2!
sources.snippet: StarCoder2 is a family of code generation models (3B, 7B, and 15B), trained on 600+ programming languages from The Stack v2 and some natural language text such as Wikipedia, Arxiv, and GitHub issues.
